loci.name: ws-401-vs-luna-all-per-method-unlock-audit
loci.one_line: Which Luna APIs flip from 401 over WS SSAP to success as root on webOS 5.4.1 04.40.16, and which remain blocked even with requiredPermissions — the per-method stock-vs-rooted table that justifies every new HA entity?
loci.rationale: Live fingerprint is the strongest evidence in the corpus: probe on 10.1.1.209 returned 401 for com.webos.applicationManager/getForegroundAppInfo over WS SSAP while luna-send -n 1 as root succeeded (cluster ws-401-vs-luna-privilege). Security Guide (security-guide-webos-open-source-edition) explains ACG + TrustLevel dev/part/oem and that requiredPermissions in appinfo.json generates client-permissions/roles, while Luna service bus note (luna-service-bus-webos-homebrew-project) confirms luna-send as root has the 'all' pseudo-role versus luna-send-pub restricted to public, with roles stored in /var/luna-service2 versus /var/luna-service2-dev. LS2 API Index (ls2-api-index-webos-open-source-edition) lists 30+ services but gives no stock/root matrix; piccap (github-tbsnillerpiccap-piccap-hyperion-sender-app-ambilight-for-lg-webos-tvs-git) and hyperion-webos (github-webosbrewhyperion-webos-hyperionng-video-grabber-for-webos-github) prove tv.capture/scaler private capture via libvt/libhalgal needs elevate-service. Width corpus gestures at the model but never enumerates the differential for HA-relevant methods: com.webos.service.tv.* (getChannelList, getCurrentChannel, getSystemSettings), com.webos.service.config, com.webos.service.audio UMI routing (comwebosserviceaudio-webos-open-source-edition), com.webos.service.cec, com.webos.service.capture/executeOneShot, com.webos.service.power2, com.palm.activitymanager. Depth must run ls-monitor -i per service and inspect api.json/groups.json on the live TV, then build the audit table that section 1 and the bidirectional matrix depend on.

opposing_positions.position: Root via luna-send as root essentially bypasses LS2 ACLs — most TV-private methods returning 401 over WS become available as root, so audit should treat rooted as unlocking essentially all com.webos.service.tv.* plus capture/audio/cec (proven by hyperion-webos native libvt capture and piccap elevate-service pattern).

Injecting requiredPermissions in appinfo.json can unlock a disciplined subset without root — appinstaller generates LS2 client permissions/roles, so stock vs rooted is ACG-dependent not binary; some endpoints become 200 over WS if companion declares correct ACG, and only truly private/oem methods need root.

loci.name: ws-peer-vs-mqtt-brokered-hybrid-discovery
loci.one_line: Persistent WebSocket re-using bscpylgtv ws:3000 coordinator versus MQTT discovery with retain/birth/will — or hybrid negotiated via mDNS/SSDP — for HA companion local_push, and how client-key reuse + TLS is actually implemented?
loci.rationale: Contradiction cluster ws-vs-mqtt-transport is high relevance and genuinely unresolved: bscpylgtv webos_client.py (bscpylgtvbscpylgtvwebos_clientpy-at-master-chros73bscpylgtv-github, 2112 lines, StorageSqliteDict .aiopylgtv.sqlite client_key, is_registered/register_state_update_callback) and aiowebostv (github-home-assistant-libsaiowebostv-python-library-to-control-lg-webos-based-tv) use ws:3000/3001 subscriptions and power/volume/app discovery reused in HA core webostv coordinator (corehomeassistantcomponentswebostv__init__py-at-dev-home-assistantcore-github local_push with async_handle_update). MQTT note (mqtt-home-assistant) shows HA-native discovery, availability topics, birth/last-will and auto entity creation that WebSocket lacks. SSDP (simple-service-discovery-protocol-ssdp-home-assistant urn:lge-com:service:webos-second-screen:1) and zeroconf (zero-configuration-networking-zeroconf-home-assistant mDNS) define discovery ownership, while Security Guide plus bscpylgtv sqlite shows client-key pairing can be reused. Corpus never resolves LAN TLS (wss port 3001 with self-signed), token rotation lifecycle, minimal requiredPermissions set for companion, reconnect semantics (HA coordinator vs MQTT broker), capability negotiation versioning, or Platinum rules inject-websession + dependency-is-async. Depth must prototype both transports on live 10.1.1.209 and measure retain/reconnect.

opposing_positions.position: Peer WebSocket re-using existing ws:3000 client-key is sufficient — it preserves bscpylgtv/coordinator state-update-callback model, needs no broker, fits local_push, and companion can advertise capabilities over the same channel with mDNS for discovery.

MQTT with HA discovery is the edge-node idiom — broker handles reconnect, retained state, last-will availability, birth messages, and multi-entity fan-out better than bespoke WS, and discovery auto-creates entities without coordinator polling; WS should be fallback only.

Home Assistant mDNS SSDP urn lge webos-second-screen companion capability negotiation advertisement

loci.name: credentialless-root-probe-overlay-ota-survival
loci.one_line: What unauthenticated probe cascade (telnet:23 banner, Dropbear 22, /media/developer overlay, /var/lib/webosbrew/startup.sh + init.d, org.webosbrew.hbchannel.service) reliably detects webosbrew root in HA SSDP config flow and what survives reboot/OTA/failsafe?
loci.rationale: Query explicitly mandates auto-detection without credentials before offering consented IPK install on 10.1.1.209 OLED48CXPTA 5.4.1. Notes confirm SSDP (simple-service-discovery-protocol-ssdp-home-assistant) and zeroconf (zero-configuration-networking-zeroconf-home-assistant) ownership for webostv discovery, while Homebrew Channel note (github-webosbrewwebos-homebrew-channel-unofficial-webos-tv-homebrew-store-and-ro) documents unauthenticated telnet:23, Dropbear 22, /media/developer overlay, hbchannel.service luna://org.webosbrew.hbchannel.service/{install,exec,spawn} with SHA256, and startup.sh copied to /var/lib/webosbrew/startup.sh plus /var/lib/webosbrew/init.d startup hooks. Rooting notes (rooting-webos-homebrew, github-rootmytvrootmytvgithubio-rootmytv-is-a-user-friendly-exploit-for-rootingj) show RootMyTV patched mid-2022 and faultmanager/dejavuln-autoroot (github-throwaway96faultmanager-autoroot-exploit-to-root-webos-40-tvs-and-set-up, github-throwaway96dejavuln-autoroot-exploit-to-root-webos-tvs-using-dejavuln-and) as current 4.0+ methods, but CanI.RootMy.TV (canirootmytv) remains the compat oracle. Corpus gives no tested cascade that avoids false positives from devmode (/var/luna-service2-dev), distinguishes present-but-not-rooted hbchannel (exec returns non-root), avoids aggressive port-scan heuristics that breach Platinum diagnostics privacy, or maps signals to test_before_configure + reauth. Also absent: which overlay paths survive firmware OTA and when failsafe telnet emergency shell is exposed (/var/luna/preferences/webosbrew_failsafe). Depth must infer from webosbrew startup.sh source and live probing of nyx/system hardware signals.

loci.name: capture-pipeline-soc-memory-voice-roll
loci.one_line: Under OLED48CX 5.x SoC/memory limits, which edge-node feats — libvt/libhalgal/unicapture HDMI capture with AI Picture Pro conflict, CEC hub, UMI audio/voice satellite, Enact Lovelace dashboard — are feasible and which genuinely require elevated native binary companions?
loci.rationale: The 'mind-blowingly useful' roadmap (sub-Q12) hinges on feasibility not wishlist. LS2 API Index (ls2-api-index-webos-open-source-edition) lists com.webos.service.cec, com.webos.service.audio (comwebosserviceaudio-webos-open-source-edition UMI routing, audio.operation ACG), avoutput, pipeline.camera, ai.voice but gives no ACG or stock accessibility; piccap (github-tbsnillerpiccap-piccap-hyperion-sender-app-ambilight-for-lg-webos-tvs-git) and hyperion-webos (github-webosbrewhyperion-webos-hyperionng-video-grabber-for-webos-github) prove HDMI capture demands root native service with unicapture blending vtCapture + halgal + quirks bitmasks and flatbuffer to hyperion/hyperhdr (github-webosbrewhyperhdr-webos-loader-github, github-webosbrewhyperionng-webos-loader-github). ActivityManager (activity-manager-api-reference-guide-webos-tv-developer) and App Lifecycle (app-lifecycle-management-webos-tv-developer) plus JS Service Usage (js-service-usage-webos-tv-developer 5s idle, 'Don't run for minutes due memory') and JS FAQ (javascript-service-faq-webos-tv-developer keepAlive Activity) show memoryd/sam kills headless ambitions. Magic Remote (magic-remote-webos-tv-developer) and notifications (notifications-webos-tv-developer, comwebosnotification-webos-open-source-edition) bound input/overlay UX for dashboard. Corpus has no measured footprint for Enact Lovelace on CX 3GB SoC, no test of CEC injection without root, no STT/TTS via com.webos.service.ai.voice, and no power penalty of persistent capture — an audited absence that depth must fill via gray literature, piccap/hyperion-webos issues, and OpenLGTV Discord practitioner posts tagged with provenance.

loci.name: platinum-2026-8-strict-typing-second-mode
loci.one_line: Exact Gold→Platinum gap for ha-lg-webos-tv wrapping bscpylgtv 0.5.3 (sync) to HA 2026.8 — strict-typing/py.typed, async-dependency, inject-websession, runtime_data, diagnostics, translations, reconfigure — and how second-mode capability negotiation adds entities with graceful fallback?
